briefTitle: Testing the Addition of a Type of Drug Called Immunotherapy to the Usual Chemotherapy Treatment for Non-small Cell Lung Cancer, an ALCHEMIST Treatment Trial (Chemo-IO [ACCIO])

typedChecks.sourceText: Age >= 18 years
Hemoglobin >= 8 gm/dl
Calculated (Calc.) creatinine clearance >= 45 mL/min
Total bilirubin =< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Total bilirubin =< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Local testing of PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (IHC) using one of the following assays: DAKO 22C3, DAKO 28-8, EIL3N or SP263
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires specific assay testing without specifying a numerical PD-L1 expression cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Note: Patients with pathologic N2 disease, completely resected, are eligible. However, patients known to have N2 disease prior to surgery are not eligible; guidelines do not recommend up-front surgery for this population
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires nuanced clinical history regarding the timing of N2 disease diagnosis relative to surgery.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Complete recovery from surgery. Registration to A081801 must be 30-77 days following surgery
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes a specific post-operative window (30-77 days) alongside subjective complete recovery.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy for current lung cancer diagnosis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Excludes prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy which is broad and not captured by simple prior_therapy_excluded typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ transplant exclusion is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must NOT have uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, serious ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, unstable angina pectoris, that would limit compliance with study requirements
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Involves multiple complex medical conditions and investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No current pneumonitis or history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pneumonitis history requiring steroids is a complex medical history condition not covered by allowed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No active auto-immune disease that has required systemic treatment within the last 2 years (e.g., disease-modifying agents, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressive drugs). Replacement therapy (e.g., thyroxine, insulin, or physiologic corticosteroid release therapy for adrenal or pituitary insufficiency) is not considered a form of systemic treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active autoimmune disease and treatment timeframes require clinical interpretation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No patients with a "currently active" second malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the last 3 years. Participants with non-melanoma skin cancers, low grade or low-risk cancers, or stage I malignancies not requiring systemic therapy (e.g., prostate cancer requiring only observation or superficial bladder cancer), or carcinoma in situ (e.g., breast carcinoma or cervical cancer in situ) that have undergone potentially curative therapy are eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex criteria regarding second malignancies with multiple specific exceptions and timeframes.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No live vaccine within 30 days prior to registration. Examples of live vaccines include, but are not limited to, the following: measles, mumps, rubella, varicella/zoster (chicken pox), yellow fever, rabies, Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG), and typhoid vaccine. Seasonal influenza vaccines for injection are generally killed virus vaccines and are allowed; however, intranasal influenza vaccines (e.g., FluMist) are live attenuated vaccines and are not allowed
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Live vaccine washout window is not a simple lab cutoff and involves specific vaccination rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No known hepatitis C virus (defined as HCV ribonucleic acid [RNA] [qualitative] is detected) infection or known history of hepatitis B (defined as hepatitis B surface antigen [HBsAg] reactive)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific virology testing criteria for Hepatitis B and C are not a single typed lab check kind.
